status: CURRENT_NATIVE_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION: six grassy portages and five native cave12 stairs; former high-cliff jumps closed. Terrain/art/events/actors/permissions are unchanged by this source-only reconciliation.

entry_contract.native_lifecycle_status: Candidate only. Existing native paid preserve remains closed until Root implements Safari admission/session/capture lifecycle.

cut_gates.purpose: Reach the enclosed thicket through Pine Pocket's grassy portage and native Cut gate. Its actual Safari table favors Shedstag and Gougecrest; ordinary Pine Portage rates, levels and flee thresholds remain unchanged outside this clearing.
cut_gates.native_return_contract: Continue and ordinary map return regenerate the temporary tree. A player inside can recut from core(10,32) facing north, walk out and relaunch; no permanent Cut event flag is invented.

docks.role: Closed west walking end; one intentional north-facing native Surf mouth beside the cap. No basecamp edge warp.
West-facing Surf landing; land connects east to safe retirement ranger.
West-facing Surf dock returning to the main lake, linked to Dorothy's yard by a short pine footpath.

portages.role: Reed pocket portage and a longer grassy approach from the fenced checkpoint; both launches remain dry.
Dismount from connected main water, cross a pine/grass neck, relaunch into Pine Pocket Lake.
Cross the pine peninsula through thick grass instead of paddling around its southern tip; the two lake arms remain connected.
